exposure: Staged surgical repair using a wound retractor as a silo
outcome: Reduction of liver and intestines into the abdomen
Secondary closure of the abdominal cavity
cohort: Two infants with ruptured giant omphaloceles and gastroschisis with total liver herniation.
finding: The staged surgical repair using a wound retractor successfully achieved reduction of the liver and intestines and secondary abdominal closure within the first 1 to 2 weeks of life in both reported cases.
